{
  "verdict": "revise",
  "score": 0.42,
  "reasons": [
    "Artifact is incomplete/truncated and ends mid-section; many sections requested are missing or underdeveloped (e.g., 3–6 kW PV sizing guidance, warranty practices, environmental impacts and recyclability, primary sources with links and dates).",
    "Content includes discussion of NMC and general comparisons, but the instruction asked for a focused LFP-focused report; depth on LFP-specific performance, safety, lifecycle, and vendor landscape is uneven.",
    "Quantitative data is partial or generalized (e.g., ranges for installed $/kWh and standalone $/kWh exist, but there is no comprehensive, section-by-section table of metrics or explicit DoD, calendar life figures by system size, or system-level efficiency ranges with clear uncertainties).",
    "No explicit list of primary sources with links and dates is provided, and there are no dedicated tables or figures that summarize key metrics with clearly labeled uncertainty ranges."
  ],
  "guidance": "To revise: (1) produce a complete LFP-focused, structured markdown report (not NMC-centric) with all requested sections; (2) include a dedicated 'Typical costs' subsection containing installed $/kWh and standalone/module-level $/kWh with regional ranges and notes on incentives; (3) provide explicit DoD, cycle life, calendar life metrics for LFP, with ranges and uncertainties; (4) enumerate common vendors/models for home use (current, regionally relevant) and include model-level specs; (5) add a detailed 'Typical sizing guidance for a 3–6 kW PV household' with example calculations (required battery kWh, inverter compatibility, HV/DC coupling considerations, and load shaping); (6) discuss safety considerations, BMS roles, warranty practices, and environmental impacts/recyclability; (7) include primary sources with links and dates, and present a quantitative table(s) of key metrics; (8) ensure the document is coherent, non-truncated, and properly linked to sources."
}
